format: provider-neutral named functions; host must register and route them

tools.name: lookup_symbols
tools.description: Read original glossary rows, migration statuses, surrounding prose and indexed composite references. Search does not approve an entry. Follow section pointers when retrieval_complete is false.

section_filter.description: Optional substring of a source section title, e.g. Inventory: tone-value.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read unchanged spec or glossary text. Use section=index to discover IDs. start_line is relative to the chosen section/document. Follow next_start_line while has_more is true.

tools.name: get_examples
tools.description: Retrieve unchanged glossary examples and their original preceding context. Examples retain draft qualifications and are not parser-certified.
